test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the simple interest of Rs. 320 at the rate of 1(1)/(2)\% per annum in 2(1)/(2) years?
solution:
**Given:-**

Principal (P) = Rs. 320 

Rate (R) = 3/2% per annum

Time (T) = 5/2 years 

**Formula used:- **

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T)

**Calculation:-**

SI = (320 × 3 × 5)/2 × 2× 100 ⇒12

**∴ The required result will be __12__.**
